result.question: Where does the man of God go after the lie?

readings.support: went back with him, ate bread in his house

assessments.reason: The passage says he “went back with him” and “ate bread in his house,” indicating he returned to the old prophet’s house; this aligns in event with the key’s “Back to eat and drink,” though it emphasizes location rather than the eating/drinking.
